data.title: Rafael CEO: We ended the Iran war with more interceptors than we started with | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: As countries scramble to increase their missile interceptor stockpile, Rafael's new facility in Arkansas is expected to have the capacity to produce 1,000 Tamir interceptors a year
